# Nexyn Studios — Complete Information Index

> Nexyn Studios is a custom software development company in India specializing in scalable web applications, mobile apps, CRM systems, and AI automation.

## Company Overview
Nexyn Studios designs, builds, and maintains custom software for startups, growing businesses, and organizations worldwide. We focus on direct communication with engineers, fast 2–4 week sprints, and full IP/source code ownership.

- Website: https://nexynstudios.com
- Location: 102, A Wing, Nehal CHS, Last Mahada, Malwani, Malad West, Mumbai 400095, Maharashtra, India
- Phone: +91 85910 13795
- Email: nexynstudios@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday - Saturday, 09:00 - 19:00 IST

## Core Services

### Custom Software Development
URL: https://nexynstudios.com/services/custom-development
We engineer bespoke CRM platforms, ERP systems, and workflow portals designed around exact organizational requirements.

### Web Application Development
URL: https://nexynstudios.com/services/web-development
Full-stack web applications built on Next.js, React, Node.js, and TypeScript, engineered for speed, high SEO scores, and enterprise security.

### Mobile App Development
URL: https://nexynstudios.com/services/mobile-app-development
Native and cross-platform apps using React Native and Flutter for iOS and Android, focusing on rapid rendering and native device features.

### UI/UX Design
URL: https://nexynstudios.com/services/ui-ux-design
User research, high-fidelity wireframing, interactive prototyping, and unified design systems in Figma.

### AI & Automation
URL: https://nexynstudios.com/services/ai-automation
Intelligent automation workflows, custom LLM integrations, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and data extraction pipelines.

### Cloud & DevOps
URL: https://nexynstudios.com/services/cloud-devops
Containerization with Docker, Kubernetes orchestration, CI/CD automated deployment, and AWS/GCP cloud architecture.
